[[File:Valorum-SWE.png|thumb|Chancellor Valorum in his Veda cloth robe]]

'''Veda cloth''' was the fabric out of which most [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|chancery]] robes were made. [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] attire, for instance, was made of brown veda cloth.
